children: Overview
U.S. regional bank's Q3 net income and EPS rose yr/yr
Net interest income and margin improved yr/yr, offsetting lower retail mortgage revenue
Company maintained quarterly dividend at $0.10 per share
Outlook
Company expects $3 mln in annualized savings from vendor consolidation and statement services starting early 2027
Primis says it is making changes to address lower retail mortgage volumes and preserve future upside
Result Drivers
CORE BANK MARGIN EXPANSION - Co said core margin expanded 14 basis points linked-quarter, supporting steady growth at attractive margins
NET INTEREST INCOME GROWTH - Net interest income rose 25% yr/yr, driven by earning asset growth funded at attractive incremental margins
RETAIL MORTGAGE PIPELINE IMPACT - Retail mortgage pipeline fell 37%, reducing revenue by $2.3 mln vs Q2, per CEO Dennis J. Zember, Jr.
